title: Cross-lingual Hate Speech Detection using Transformer Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing and evaluating hate speech classification performance (using macro and weighted average metrics) across monolingual (English-to-English, French-to-French) and cross-lingual (English-to-French, French-to-English) settings to assess performance disparities and transferability between languages.

Qualitative manual error analysis of misclassified texts, which revealed that the models are frequently confused by and erroneously classify sentences explicitly mentioning specific ethnic or religious identity groups (e.g., Arabs, Jews, or exclamatory Islamophobic statements).
Qualitative manual error analysis of misclassified inputs, observing that the models struggle to correctly classify sentences that explicitly contain political orientations (e.g., 'gauchiste').
